Company Description HR Beacon is a dedicated HR consulting firm focused on helping organizations build stronger, more efficient, and people-centered workplaces. The firm provides tailored solutions in recruitment, talent management, performance development, payroll, and compliance for businesses of all sizes. With a strong understanding of human capital and organizational needs, HR Beacon designs strategies that support sustainable growth. The company’s mission is to empower clients with the tools and insights needed to attract, retain, and develop top talent while serving as a trusted partner on their path to success.

Role Description The Fulfillment Specialist / Manager is a full-time, remote role responsible for coordinating and overseeing the delivery of HR Beacon’s services to clients. This role manages end-to-end fulfillment processes, including order intake, resource allocation, and tracking the status of client engagements to ensure timely and accurate completion. The Fulfillment Specialist / Manager collaborates with internal teams to maintain inventory of HR resources and tools, resolves client issues, and supports continuous process improvement. Daily responsibilities include monitoring workflow, analyzing fulfillment data, updating systems, preparing status reports, and communicating regularly with clients and team members to maintain a high level of service and satisfaction.
q: Strong Analytical Skills to interpret data, optimize processes, and support decision-making.
Excellent Communication abilities to collaborate with internal teams and interact with clients clearly and professionally.
Customer Service skills to manage client inquiries, resolve issues, and maintain positive relationships.
Inventory Management experience to track, organize, and maintain resources, tools, and service deliverables.
Team Leadership capabilities to coordinate cross-functional efforts and guide others toward meeting fulfillment goals.
Experience in operations, fulfillment, or service delivery, preferably in consulting or professional services.
Proficiency with digital tools and platforms for project tracking, documentation, and remote collaboration.
Organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple tasks in a remote environment.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, Human Resources, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
